title: Follow-up for #1302: place-self / place-items collapsing
items: Factor the parse-side "copy the first value" mapping into helpers (`PlaceSelf::default_justify`, likewise `PlaceItems`/`PlaceContent`); use them in `parse` and in `to_css` (write the second value only when it differs), removing the hand-written `is_equal` matches.
Add a `minify_test` with the exact input from #1182.
